# Lamplighter, phase 2: materials (exact Rosy 42 colours; the glass emissive, so it bakes unlit),
# hidden faces dropped, everything joined into one Lamplighter, flat shading, export.
# Generated by make_lamplighter.py.
material new Coat --base-color 0.8118 0.4588 0.1686 --no-slot
material new Belt --base-color 0.4902 0.2196 0.2000 --no-slot
material new Dark --base-color 0.2314 0.1255 0.1529 --no-slot
material new Hat --base-color 0.3216 0.2000 0.2471 --no-slot
material new Face --base-color 1.0000 0.7608 0.6314 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.1294 0.0941 0.1059 --no-slot
material new Scarf --base-color 0.3098 0.6431 0.7216 --no-slot
material new Pole --base-color 0.5608 0.3020 0.3412 --no-slot
material new Glass --base-color 1.0000 0.9333 0.5137 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.9333 0.5137

select Coat SleeveR SleeveL Belt Button0 Button1 BootR BootL LegR LegL GloveR GloveL LampCap LampPost0 LampPost1 LampPost2 LampPost3 LampBase BrimEdge Brim Crown Head EyeR EyeL Scarf ScarfEnd Pole Hook0 Hook1 Hook2 LampGlass
